about: Maxwell Engineering Solutions Limited manufactures precision-engineered wear components including pelletizing die plates, pelletizing blades/knives, blade holders/cutter hubs, and driving bushes for underwater pelletizing systems. The company also trades related blades and components, providing customized tooling solutions. Its primary manufacturing operations are located at Waghodia GIDC in Vadodara, Gujarat.

objects.purpose: Capital expenditure for purchase of new machineries, lab equipment & other utilities
Capital expenditure for construction of new office building and manufacturing facility
Repayment / prepayment, in full or part, of certain outstanding borrowings

concentration.note: Dependent upon a few key suppliers for raw materials; steel is sourced domestically, while critical inputs carbide and brazing filler are imported.

litigation_note: Application for 'MAXWELL' device mark is opposed by Shree Vallabh Metals claiming prior use since 2010. Outstanding contingent liabilities stand at ₹2.19 crore, mainly ₹2.18 crore EPCG duty savings.
strengths: Experienced promoter and management team driving precision engineering capabilities.
Established relationships with existing industrial clients.
Comprehensive quality procedures and testing systems.
Revenue diversification across multiple domestic and international geographies.
Customized product offerings tailored to client underwater pelletizing specifications.
In-house research and development capabilities supporting component enhancement.

risks.title: Dependence on Few Raw Material Suppliers
risks.detail: The company relies heavily on a few suppliers for key raw materials like steel; any supply disruption could impair manufacturing schedules.

risks.title: Exposure to Raw Material Imports
risks.detail: Critical raw materials including Carbide and Brazing Filler are imported, making production costs vulnerable to forex volatility and tariff changes.

risks.title: Working Capital Intensity
risks.detail: Working capital requirements have surged over the past three fiscals to fund expanding inventory and receivables.

risks.title: Unhedged Foreign Exchange Fluctuations
risks.detail: The company engages in exports and raw material imports without derivative or hedging contracts, exposing profits to currency swings.

risks.title: EPCG Scheme Export Obligations
risks.detail: The company saved ₹2.18 crore in customs duty under the EPCG scheme; failure to fulfill export obligations may trigger differential duties and penalties.

risks.title: Opposition to Trademark Registration
risks.detail: The device mark 'MAXWELL' is under opposition proceedings initiated by Shree Vallabh Metals, threatening brand protection.

risks.title: Unplaced Orders for Proposed Capital Expenditure
risks.detail: No firm purchase orders have been placed for the planned ₹24.50 crore capital expenditure on new machineries and construction.

risks.title: Contingent Liabilities
risks.detail: Contingent liabilities totaled ₹2.19 crore as of July 31, 2026, which could adversely affect liquidity if materialized.

notes: Restated financial figures are standalone. Four-month stub period ended July 31, 2026 has been excluded from array metrics in line with instructions.
